description: This file defines the Opencart Admin Controller for managing SEO URLs, including listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting SEO URL entries within the Opencart e-commerce platform's backend.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative operations for SEO URL management within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial entry point that sets up the SEO URL management page, including filters, breadcrumbs, store and language data, and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct requests to display the list of SEO URLs.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of SEO URLs, supporting filtering, sorting, pagination, and linking.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a SEO URL record, populating fields with existing data if applicable.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and processes form submissions to add or update SEO URL records in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected SEO URL records, after permission checks, and returns success or error messages.
